name: Sea Captain, Rookie (CR 1)
body:
SEA CAPTAIN, ROOKIE
CR 1

Human valkyrie (vala) 1/champion 1
NG medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +1 Dex, +1 shield), -2 while raging hp 17 (1d10+2+5)
Fort +4, Ref +1, Will +3; +2 Will when in a rage
Defensive Abilities hard to kill

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.

Melee broadsword +6 (2d4+3), +8 (2d4+5) while raging
Ranged shortbow +2 (1d6/x3)
Special Attacks flash of rage, mythic power 5/day, rage 1 round/day, surge +1d6, sudden attack, vanquish foe 1/day (+2 attack, +1 damage)
Mystery Ancestor

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 12, Con 14,, Int 11,, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +1; CMB +5; CMD 15
Traits Bred for War, Call of the Longships
Feats Vala’s Curse*, Weapon Focus M (broadsword)
Skills Intimidate +7, Perception +5, Profession (sailor) +3, Survival +5, Swim +7
Languages Northern Common
SQ oracle’s curse (wrath), revelation (wisdom of the ancestors 1/day, augury, 80%)
Gear broadsword (20 gp), chain shirt (100 gp), light steel shield (9 gp), shortbow (30 gp) with 20 arrows (1 gp), valkyrie’s kit (10 gp), 5 gp
